description: Codex harness surface for view-limits — wiring only, no logic. PreToolUse runs the dispatch gate (network-free, cache-only, fail-open) and SessionStart refreshes the cache. Both delegate to bin/vl.js; every value is rendered by the CLI. Requires [features] codex_hooks = true in config.toml. Set VIEW_LIMITS_ROOT to the view-limits checkout; unset, the path resolves from the session git root (repo-local install).
